# Claude Code 2.1.311 capture sanitization

These fixtures were produced by the repository census harness and sanitized with the shared engine and Claude-specific privacy rules. Native protocol keys, value types, ordering and stable joins are retained; private identifiers, paths and content are redacted. Raw carriers and auxiliary logs were not uploaded.

The complete capture ran on native Linux in workflow [41782999182](https://github.com/vibefield/puppeteer/actions/runs/41782999182), from 2026-11-04T06:04:50Z through 2026-11-04T06:05:43Z. All nine modes ran in the network-deny sandbox with zero non-loopback attempts. Runtime claims use the census completion time; binary probes retain their original capture time.

The captured executable SHA-256 is `86dc1fcc69498159eaf15f446613e847010f9036bfbbdffd4c49350be8489ada`, matching the retained linux-x64 binary probe. `sandbox.json` retains the successful network-denial proof. The official marketplace bootstrap was disabled explicitly in the disposable environment.
